7936-peeps-at-many-lands-japan.creator: Unknown

They have proved themselves, like the English, brave and clever on the sea, while their troops have fought as nobly as British soldiers on the land.

arxiv-2006-07097.title: Solid-liquid coexistence of the noble elements. II. Neon, krypton and xenon
arxiv-2006-07097.creator: Aditya N. Singh, Jeppe C. Dyre, Ulf R. Pedersen
arxiv-2006-07097.description: Abstract The noble elements constitute the simplest group in the periodic table. At low temperatures or high pressures, the liquid phase solidifies into a face-centered cubic crystal structure (except helium). In the companion paper, we investigated the fcc solid-liquid coexistence of argon in the light of hidden scale invariance. Here we extend the investigation to neon, argon, krypton, and xenon.

arxiv-2011-12482.title: CellSegmenter: unsupervised representation learning and instance segmentation of modular images
arxiv-2011-12482.creator: Luca D’Alessio Data Sciences Platform, Broad Institute 415 Main St, Cambridge, MA 02142 ldalessi@broadinstitute.org, Mehrtash Babadi Data Sciences Platform, Broad Institute 415 Main St, Cambridge, MA 02142 mehrtash@broadinstitute.org
arxiv-2011-12482.description: Abstract We introduce CellSegmenter, a structured deep generative model and an amortized inference framework for unsupervised representation learning and instance segmentation tasks. The proposed inference algorithm is convolutional and parallelized, without any recurrent mechanisms, and is able to resolve object-object occlusion while simultaneously treating distant non-occluding objects independently.

arxiv-2108-11628.title: Quasienergy operators and generalized squeezed states for systems of trapped ions
arxiv-2108-11628.creator: Bogdan M. Mihalcea
arxiv-2108-11628.description: Abstract Collective many-body dynamics for time-dependent quantum Hamiltonian functions is investigated for a dynamical system that exhibits multiple degrees of freedom, in this case a combined (Paul and Penning) trap. Quantum stability is characterized by a discrete quasienergy spectrum, while the quasienergy states are symplectic coherent states.

arxiv-2405-13349.title: \sys : A Verifiable Logical Clock for P2P Networks
arxiv-2405-13349.creator: Working Draft
arxiv-2405-13349.description: Abstract . Logical clocks are a fundamental tool to establish causal ordering of events in a distributed system. They have been applied in weakly consistent storage systems, causally ordered broadcast, distributed snapshots, deadlock detection, and distributed system debugging. However, prior logical clock constructs fail to work in an open network with Byzantine participants.

arxiv-2408-05372.title: PRISM Lite: A lightweight model for interactive 3D placenta segmentation in ultrasound
arxiv-2408-05372.creator: Hao Li, Baris Oguz, Gabriel Arenas, Xing Yao, Jiacheng Wang, Alison Pouch, Brett Byram, Nadav Schwartz, Ipek Oguz
arxiv-2408-05372.description: Abstract Placenta volume measured from 3D ultrasound (3DUS) images is an important tool for tracking the growth trajectory and is associated with pregnancy outcomes. Manual segmentation is the gold standard, but it is time-consuming and subjective. Although fully automated deep learning algorithms perform well, they do not always yield high-quality results for each case.

arxiv-2408-07420.title: Low inertia reversing geodynamos
arxiv-2408-07420.creator: Chris A. Jones, Yue-Kin Tsang
arxiv-2408-07420.description: Abstract Convection driven geodynamo models in rotating spherical geometry have regimes in which reversals occur. However, reversing dynamo models are usually found in regimes where the kinetic and magnetic energy is comparable, so that inertia is playing a significant role in the core dynamics.

arxiv-2408-16729.title: Prediction-Feedback DETR for Temporal Action Detection
arxiv-2408-16729.creator: Jihwan Kim Miso Lee Cheol-Ho Cho Jihyun Lee Jae-Pil Heo
arxiv-2408-16729.description: Abstract Temporal Action Detection (TAD) is fundamental yet challenging for real-world video applications. Leveraging the unique benefits of transformers, various DETR-based approaches have been adopted in TAD. However, it has recently been identified that the attention collapse in self-attention causes the performance degradation of DETR for TAD.

arxiv-2505-20100.title: AdaTP: Attention-Debiased Token Pruning for Video Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-20100.creator: Fengyuan Sun, Leqi Shen, Hui Chen, Sicheng Zhao, Jungong Han, Guiguang Ding
arxiv-2505-20100.description: Abstract Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable results in video understanding tasks. However, they often suffer from heavy computational overhead due to the large number of visual tokens generated from multiple video frames. Existing visual token compression methods often rely on attention scores from language models as guidance.

arxiv-2512-16985.title: Marc Riembau
arxiv-2512-16985.creator: a
arxiv-2512-16985.description: Abstract The N N -point energy correlator measures the energy flux through N N detectors. We present a general framework that characterizes its full angular dependence in a series of spinning energy correlators . These spinning correlators resurrect the angular momentum structure of both the source and the detector configuration, lost otherwise in inclusive measurements.

pmc-10498569.title: Cardiometabolic healthcare for men with prostate cancer: an MD Anderson Cancer Center experience
pmc-10498569.creator: Andrew W Hahn, Whittney Thoman, Efstratios Koutroumpakis, Amer Abdulla, Sumit K Subudhi, Ana Aparicio, Karen Basen-Enngquist, Christopher J Logothetis, Susan C Gilchrist
pmc-10498569.description: BackgroundMen diagnosed with prostate cancer are at risk for competing morbidity and mortality due to cardiometabolic disease given their advanced age at diagnosis, high prevalence of pre-existing risk factors, and receipt of systemic therapy that targets the androgen receptor (AR).

pmc-11499682.title: Malnutrition and Obesity in Patients with COPD Exacerbation, Insights from the National Inpatient Sample
pmc-11499682.creator: Mohamad El Labban, Roba El-Zibaoui, Syed Muhammad Usama, Fayreal Niaz, Abbe Cohen, Peter Krastev, Syed Khan, Salim Surani
pmc-11499682.description: BackgroundThe obesity paradox suggests that obese patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Exacerbation (COPDE) may have better outcomes. COPD patients are at a higher risk of becoming malnourished, which has been linked to poor outcomes.ObjectiveThis paper aims to study the impact of malnutrition in patients with and without obesity hospitalized with COPDE.

pmc-12466962.title: Unraveling the Bone–Brain Communication Network
pmc-12466962.creator: Surajit Hansda, Hiranmoy Das
pmc-12466962.description: Simple SummaryAlthough the brain and bones seem unrelated, new research shows they communicate in surprising ways. Chemicals released by bones can affect brain functions like memory and mood, while the brain sends signals that influence bone growth and strength. This two-way connection helps maintain the health of both systems.

pmc-12723519.title: Genome Sequence of Arthrobacter globiformis B-2979 phage Ichiang
pmc-12723519.creator: Jazmine Aftabi, Shivani Gangireddy, Uttej Kollu, Charlie Lu, Calista K Ly, Luke A Metcalf, Eshaan Patnaik, Dhruv Reddy, Jacob Taylor, Harry Teng, William Turula, Nalani M Wooton, Annie Zhou, Nancy E Castro
pmc-12723519.description: Bacteriophage Ichiang is a siphovirus capable of infecting Arthrobacter globiformis B2979. The genome has a length of 41,984 base pairs with 64.8 % GC content and contains 64 predicted protein-coding genes and 1 tRNA gene. Based on gene content, Ichiang has been assigned to Actinobacteriophage FF cluster. A) Negative-stain transmission electron micrograph revealed a siphovirus morphology. Scale bar is 100nm.

pmc-13120117.title: The Influence of Individualization in External Load Control on Anaerobic Performance in a Women’s Soccer Team
pmc-13120117.creator: Alexandre Galvão da Silva, Caroline Cavalcanti de Freitas, Alef Serrat Pinheiro, Débora Dias Ferraretto Moura Rocco, Caroline Simões Teixeira, Luis Alberto Rosan, Rodrigo Kallás Zogaib
pmc-13120117.description: Soccer is an intermittent sport that requires complex and well-adjusted physiological responses from athletes. The training load allows athletes to optimize physical adaptations and reduces the risk of musculoskeletal injuries. In women’s soccer, the implementation of load control and individualization strategies has shown promise for enhancing anaerobic performance and injury prevention.

pmc-13296096.title: Crosstalk Between Oxidative Stress, Protein Glycation, and Extracellular Matrix Remodeling in the Skin of Rats with Type 1 Diabetes: Does Insulin Administration Improve Skin Homeostasis?
pmc-13296096.creator: Natalia Dorf, Edyta Gołaś, Cezary Pawlukianiec, Małgorzata Żendzian-Piotrowska, Anna Zalewska, Mateusz Maciejczyk
pmc-13296096.description: The exact mechanisms of skin involvement in type 1 diabetes (DM1) remain poorly understood. This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between antioxidants, oxidative stress, protein glycation, and glycoxidation, as well as matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) activity, in the skin of rats with DM1, while investigating whether insulin administration improves skin homeostasis.

pmc-13599966.title: Prevalence of and factors associated with obesity during pregnancy in Ireland 2013–2022: a retrospective observational study from a large tertiary maternity hospital
pmc-13599966.creator: Ellen Juliet Cosgrave, Mark Germaine, Peter Naughton, Margaret Mary Brennan, Patricia M Kearney, Graham Healy, Brendan Egan, Michael J Turner, Claire Buckley, Amy C O’Higgins
pmc-13599966.description: IntroductionThis study describes the prevalence of and factors associated with obesity during pregnancy (body mass index (BMI) ≥30.0 kg/m²) among women attending a tertiary maternity hospital in Dublin, Ireland, where 1 in 8 deliveries occur nationally.MethodsThe study involved secondary analysis of electronic health records from The Coombe Hospital from 2013 to 2022.
